steps.speaker: 9th Agency Agent
steps.content: The intel collection on target Synex is complete, Chief. Here is the operation report for your review.

steps.speaker: 9th Agency Agent
steps.content: As you predicted, we found extensive evidence of combat between humans and the Apostles of Ashes in the heart of WhiteSands. Several sites contained scattered Aurum Secretum fragments. By analyzing the age and distribution of these traces, we've pinpointed the target's encampment. The coordinates are on the final page.
What about the search vessel? Did you find it? Were there any survivors?
The agent shakes his head, his expression darkening.

steps.speaker: 9th Agency Agent
steps.content: No... we went back to check. The ship was completely empty.

steps.speaker: 9th Agency Agent
steps.content: Not only were there no survivors... but everything on board—resources, files, equipment—was torn to shreds by that woman. ...There was nothing left to return to their families.
...I see. Thank you for your efforts. I'll add this to the records.
As the agent departs, you massage the bridge of your nose and turn your attention to the report.
To your surprise, it contains more leads than you expected. Synex isn't even trying to conceal her whereabouts; finding her will be the easy part.
...The real problem is what comes next. When you find her, a brutal confrontation is inevitable.
[Flashback: Hella vs Synex Confrontation CG + Restraint CG]

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Chief, I must advise against this. Reviewing the intelligence and combat footage, this operation presents a significant level of risk.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Are you certain you want to proceed without any Sinners?
Aurum Secretum's effects on Sinners are still too unpredictable. And... given Synex's history of wariness and hostility, arriving without a show of force might make her less likely to attack.
Just like she did with Hella back then.

After all, she was the one who came to your and Hecate's aid at the edge of the Black Ring. In a way, this explains the peculiar friendliness she shows you now... or whatever this particular interest of hers might be.
I'll have a tactical team on standby for immediate support if it's needed. Besides, I still have the shackles.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Understood. I trust your judgment, Chief. Please proceed with extreme caution.
[WhiteSands]
On the day of the operation, WhiteSands is unnaturally still. Not only have the sandstorms ceased, but the very traces of Mania that usually permeate the air have vanished entirely.

steps.speaker: Escort Soldier
steps.content: We've got a new lead, Chief. Look here.
Through the binoculars, the withered oasis in the distance looks like a forgotten grave. Broken logs lie stacked by a dried-up riverbed, reminiscent of a traveler's long-dead campfire.
Nearby, several dark creatures crouch in kneeling postures, while others twist and writhe on the ground, their forms so distorted it's impossible to discern their actions.
Are these bizarre movements just a part of their existence? Lowering the binoculars, you are lost in thought.
If the Alchemic Beasts are here, this is the place. They don't seem aggressive, but that doesn't confirm our target's presence.
Synex rarely travels without them. If they're here, she's likely in that camp.
I'm going in.

steps.speaker: Escort Soldier
steps.content: Chief, it's our duty to protect you. Please allow us to accompany you!

Hold your position within firing range. Do not advance any closer. Synex isn't like our other targets; she'll kill anyone who bores her without a second thought. If you get too close, there will be too many of you for me to protect.
With your backup team in position, you jump from the sand ship.
As you slowly approach the camp, an even more disturbing scene unfolds before your eyes.
Synex is hunched on the sand, crouched over the hollowed-out husk of a dead Alchemic Beast—its body glittering with infused Aurum Secretum.

She gnaws at the shell, then delicately licks up the crumbling Aurum Secretum fragments. The act is a horrifying contradiction: part savage tearing, part intimate kiss. She works methodically, from the head down the neck and chest, devouring the shell inch by inch until nothing remains.

Encircling them, other Alchemic Beasts sit in a macabre audience, their severely distorted bodies hunched forward, struggling to maintain their kneeling position. Their vacant eyes are fixed ahead, as if attending a sacred, solemn ritual.
As she swallows the Aurum Secretum, traces of frenzy ripple across her skin, a visible sign of the power being digested and resonating within her body.

steps.speaker: Escort Soldier
steps.content: Chief, we have Synex in our sights. Her energy signature is rapidly expanding. We need to interrupt her feeding immediately! Permission to open fire.
...Ungh!
You are on the verge of giving the order when a sharp resonance lances through your mind like a blade.
You grit your teeth, enduring the agony, and as it subsides, you find yourself staring directly into the eyes of an Alchemic Beast across the expanse.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: ...Hmm? Oh?
Synex has sensed the connection, too. She lifts her head, her gaze piercing the distance to find your exact position. A faint, knowing smile flickers at the corner of her mouth.

The Aurum Secretum she just consumed now flows beneath her skin, forming shifting, golden patterns. You can feel the violent Mania radiating from her, a field many times stronger than during your last encounter.

steps.speaker: Escort Soldier
steps.content: Danger! Cover the Chief!
The warning from your communicator is instantly drowned by the eruption of heavy gunfire.
The specially enhanced bullets find their mark, ripping bloody wounds across Synex's body, yet she remains utterly unfazed, charging directly toward you.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Haha... hahaha! Stationed soldiers at a distance, did you? Oh, your ammo's a bit stronger now, but it's still pathetically weak!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, you don't seriously think these bullets can hurt me, do you?
You raise your hand with lightning speed, but her ferocious strike is faster.
What—
The powerful blow connects with your chest. Under the crushing force, a deafening ring in your ears swallows all other sound, and the world before you fades to black.
[Black Screen]
You have no idea how long you've been unconscious. In your dreamlike state, strange noises begin to emerge...
Coo coo...
Mmm... coo?
Mmm... coo coo coo coo...
[WhiteSands Cave]
You open your eyes to find a grotesquely twisted Alchemic Beast staring at you, its head tilted to one side.
What... is this?
As far as you can tell, you're in a cave. Synex has bound your limbs tightly, and several Alchemic Beasts stand guard around you, likely left behind as your captors.
The Alchemic Beasts remain silent, tilting their heads in unison. You suddenly realize their gaze is fixed on something behind you.
According to the reports, deeply mutated Alchemic Beasts lose all cognitive function. They're no different from wild animals. Trying to get information from them would be a waste of time.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Well, well! My little trophy is finally awake.

A woman's voice echoes from outside. Synex saunters in, the soft swish of her dress accompanying her approach before she crouches directly in front of you. Her hand reaches out, gripping your jaw and forcing your gaze up to meet hers.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Did you sleep well?
You notice her tail swishing gently behind her, a clear sign of her amusement.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Our little encounters are always so... rushed. Never any time for a proper chat. I was hoping to see what you're really made of. But you're so... disappointing. Maybe that rumor is true after all. The Devil Wears Gray Coat is nothing without the shackles?
I told you before, Synex. The Bureau's goal was never to lock you up. We're trying to find a cure. To help you, and others like you, survive.
Synex's grip tightens incrementally, her eyes savoring every twitch of pain that contorts your features.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: I've killed a lot of people. DisCity executives, Fraser hounds, government spies... You can't possibly think I'd walk out of a Bureau cell alive.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh, wait. I forgot. You have your own little Luminaris Society, don't you? The "Ring Research Institute." That's the real plan, isn't it? Hand me over to them. Let them dissect me, experiment on me... see how your Hypercube tech stacks up against Aurum Secretum for your next war.
Killing you solves nothing. We know Aurum Secretum was developed by the Underground and Fraser. In the end, test subjects like you are victims, not criminals.

Settling a score with you is the least of our priorities. We have bigger things to deal with: the BR-005 incident, the true nature of the Famine, arranging rescue for the other test subjects... That's just the start of the list.

But I suspect you don't care about any of that. So let me give you a more personal reason. You "helped" us outside the Black Ring, and you're Hella's "friend"... so I will do everything in my power to keep you alive.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Ohhh, aren't you clever? Using my sweet little Hella as bait.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: I take it back. Even without your shackles, the Devil Wears Gray Coat still has a silver tongue.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Sure, I want to live. But if survival means becoming your pet, I'd rather take my chances in WhiteSand. Fighting Apostles, causing trouble... occasionally kidnapping a Chief for fun. Now that's a fulfilling existence.
If you don't care about your own life, what about the others? The other test subjects? Have you considered what they want? Maybe they actually want to survive.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Them? Survive?
Synex throws her head back and laughs, a sharp, mocking sound as if you'd just told the world's most hilarious joke.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Why the hell would I care what they want? After all the torture in that lab, after mutating into... this... they should've died a long time ago!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Listen, are you misunderstanding the situation? Do you think I'm their guardian? That they follow me because they want to live?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Wrong. Dead wrong! These things follow me because they want to die.
...Die?
As she speaks, Synex rests a hand on her abdomen, as if sensing the other souls residing within her.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: They believe if I eat them after they die, they'll live on inside me. Amusing, isn't it? Not that I mind. I've always had a healthy appetite. A few bites here and there are no trouble at all.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: See how strange humans are? Saffar took the Alchemic Beasts that still had a mind, and they chose a form of belonging. But these mindless things that follow me... they still crave a purpose, too.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: It's all so pointless. As if this world has enough purposes and endings to go around.
If you don't want anything, then why take me? Why make me your prisoner?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: For fun, of course!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hehehe... How could I pass up the chance to get my hands on little Hella's precious Chief? It'd be a waste not to play with you.
Her claws grip your head as she shakes it roughly from side to side, treating your skull like a stubborn control lever.

You try to wrench your head back, but she retaliates by cracking your forehead against the unyielding stone wall. A lance of pain shoots from the point of impact, and a wave of dizziness washes over you.
You...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: I like that look in your eyes. Don't worry, as long as you behave, we'll have plenty of time together.
To emphasize her point, Synex gives the top of your head two condescending pats, then flicks the bridge of your nose.
You flinch back, barely avoiding her touch.
FAC will scour WhiteSand for me. You won't be able to hide for long.
In response to your warning, Synex merely lets out a slow, exaggerated yawn.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh, really? I think it's the opposite. Letting you go is what would bring them down on me. Keeping you right here... keeps things nice and quiet.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Now, be a good little toy and keep me company. Once I get bored, I'll toss you back. Soon enough.
Having said this, she gives your head a final, sharp pat with her claws before turning and leaving the cave.
